create.name: Guri Sohal
create.bio:
Guri Sohal is a meditation and manifestation teacher from Ontario, Canada, who works under the name Grow with Guri. He mixes Buddhist meditation, drawn especially from the Abhidharma's map of the mind, with breathwork, visualisation and ideas from neuroscience and psychology, and he presents manifestation as a matter of changing your sense of identity rather than wishing. He says he has studied and practised manifestation for around eight years, and he aims his teaching at people of any background or belief.

On Insight Timer his best-known courses are Meditate Like a Monk and Breathe Like a Monk, which move from counting the breath to watching mental states, impermanence and emptiness, alongside courses on abundance, love and the science of manifesting. His YouTube channel carries a free fourteen-day meditation challenge, guided practices for quantum jumping and intention setting, and plain-spoken talks on ego, self-image and future-self work. He also hosts the podcast Meditate, Manifest and Grow, sells self-paced programmes on manifestation and wealth consciousness, and coaches creators and small business owners one-to-one. His style is direct and casual, and he works entirely online.

courses.title: Meditate Like a Monk
courses.description: An eleven-day Insight Timer course of roughly twenty minutes a day that pairs guided sitting with Buddhist-inspired teaching on the mind, suffering and compassion, building a steady daily practice.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Breathe Like a Monk
courses.description: Five twenty-minute sessions based on the Abhidharma, starting with counting breaths and moving through awareness of body, mind and mental formations to impermanence and emptiness.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Quantum Neuro Manifestation Blueprint (13 Days)
courses.description: A self-paced course of thirteen lessons with guided meditations, audio activations, visualisation and practical exercises aimed at reshaping your sense of self around what you want to create. Lifetime access and a private group are included.

courses.title: Elevate Your Wealth Consciousness
courses.description: An eleven-lesson self-paced programme on the beliefs you hold about money, with guided meditations, visualisations and hands-on exercises for a calmer, more open relationship with receiving.

free_resources.title: Guri Sohal on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Loving-kindness, mindfulness and breathing practices, along with manifestation and abundance meditations and affirmations. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Meditate, Manifest and Grow (Podcast)
free_resources.description: His free podcast of talks and guided practices on meditation, manifestation and personal growth.

free_resources.title: Rewire Your Brain (7 Day Email Course)
free_resources.description: A free week of daily emails on manifestation habits, self-confidence and raising your sense of what is normal for you.

Mainly a manifestation, money-mindset and creator/business coach and content creator; the clearly spiritual core is his Buddhist-based Insight Timer courses and YouTube meditation challenge. A human may want to check the fit.
Email is a brand support inbox (support@growithguri.com, note single 'w', which matches his join.growithguri.com domain) published as the mail link on his Stan page.
No website beyond the Stan store; no physical base found, so availability worldwide (Ontario from Insight Timer).
His Insight Timer courses are tagged anxiety and stress on the platform and his IT bio mentions overcoming depression; neither is in the plan.
The Manifestation Blueprint sales page lists health among things to 'magnetize'; not repeated in the description.
YouTube avatar has a circular frame on a coloured background; all three photos show the same man.
Stan prices are sale prices (regular price shown in brackets).
YouTube videos could not be sorted by views; picked from recent uploads.
